introduction: Oklahoma 211 connects callers with community resources through HeartLine and 211 Eastern Oklahoma. Use your location to find the appropriate regional directory.
description: Oklahoma 211 connects callers with community resources through HeartLine and 211 Eastern Oklahoma. Use your location to find the appropriate regional directory.

sections.who: You can request information without first qualifying for a public benefit. The receiving provider decides eligibility for actual assistance.
sections.get: Referrals can help locate food, housing, utilities and other local services.
sections.docs:
• County or ZIP code.
  • The type of help and any urgent date.

sections.apply:
1. Dial 211

    Use the statewide service-area page for eastern and western directory links.

  2. Describe the need

    Mention your county and urgency so the specialist can identify relevant services.

  3. Follow up with providers

    Ask about available help, intake requirements and documents.
sections.after: If a referral is unavailable, return with that result and request alternatives.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Oklahoma regional 211 routes, State-listed text and chat options. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.
